settings.shared-effect: This instance selects its display port and vibrance. Toggling changes that physical display for all instances; its saved enabled choice remains instance-local. Main/IPC actions use plugin-level settings.
settings.vibrance-value-desc: Digital vibrance intensity (0 = default, 1023 = maximum saturation)
settings.display-index-desc: Display number (1 = first port). Run 'nvibrant' to find which number shows 'Success'
